method: Independent reconstruction of numeric and mathematical methods from serialized learner prompts, tables, displayed equations and public diagrams. The author ledger is used only as an expected-value comparator after reconstruction; no authoring modules are imported. Direct cash-flow sums, exact symbolic differentiation, root-split quadrature, direct discrete probability sums, profiled nonlinear least squares, exhaustive routes, matrix exponentials and old-state Euler iterations supply alternate checks.
semanticCoverage: All 125 family narratives and markschemes were read. Each of the 500 variants was replayed from its serialized givens, with domains, branches, interval solutions, modelling assumptions, statistical conditions, signs, units, rounding, criterion counts, difficulty and answer leakage checked. Family-specific semantic decisions accompany every ID.
scopeExclusions: No complex roots, general vector-product proofs, exact complex-eigenvalue ODE solutions, Runge–Kutta or 2029 syllabus material. Matrix diagonalization and exact ODE systems use distinct real eigenvalues; spirals are interpreted qualitatively.
visualReview: All 43 unique serialized SVGs (52 uses) independently rasterized and all four sheets inspected for mathematical direction, origin/scales, explicit original coordinates, edge labels, clipping and separation of public data/private solution coordinates.
